delivery.chittagongBody: We bring your gift straight to your door.

policy.cancellationText: To receive a refund of the advance payment, cancel at least 5 days before delivery. For orders outside Chittagong, cancelling less than 2 days before delivery means paying the advance plus 30% of the total cost.
